fields.name: Id
fields.type: Guid (uniqueidentifier); max length unspecified
fields.edit: Native identity only; no user edit
fields.lifecycle: Native creation allocates identity; preserve duplicate-name binding ambiguity with inherited Id until tenant verification.

fields.name: Project Owner
fields.type: M:1 to Employee (SysEmployeeEntity); many → 0..1; no named inverse exported; Inferred from foreign-key relation and declaring start; requiredness extracted
fields.edit: Responsible engineer or administrator selects current eligible internal engineer; required before Issue; audited reassignment while open
fields.lifecycle: Issue and all engineer actions recheck assignment; existing ProjectOwner is the sole responsible-engineer field.

fields.name: PPAP Due Date
fields.type: Date (Date); max length unspecified; TimeZoneCapture=false
fields.default: None; engineer supplies overall due date at Draft creation, or originating APQP launch explicitly copies its linked Task due date once when present; no unconditional Task expression
fields.edit: Engineer editable while open with mandatory date-change reason; supplier read only
fields.lifecycle: Current overall PPAP due date; target adapter stops unguarded bidirectional Task.DueDate overwrites; audit old/new/reason.

fields.name: Settings
fields.type: M:1 to APQP Settings (APQP_SettingsObject); many → 1; no named inverse exported; Inferred from foreign-key relation and declaring start; requiredness extracted
fields.edit: System selected existing APQP Settings; hidden from suppliers
fields.lifecycle: Create handler satisfies required compatibility metadata; guard old settings-dependent handlers for target branch.

fields.name: Task
fields.type: M:1 to Integrated Task (ProjectFwk_TaskObject); many → 0..1; reverse PPAPs; Inferred from foreign-key relation and declaring start; requiredness extracted
fields.edit: System populated by originating APQP launch; authorized internal navigation only
fields.lifecycle: Compatibility relationship unchanged; approval emits outcome and completes only a single explicitly bound obligation after scope-aware checks; multiple linked PPAPs require originating owner/adapter resolution. Cancellation flags owner without successful fulfilment.

fields.name: APQP Abstract
fields.type: 1:M to APQP (APQP_APQPObject); inverse collection; no new stored reference; reverse PPAPAbstract; Inferred from foreign-key inverse and declaring end
fields.edit: Read-only authorized internal navigation
fields.lifecycle: Existing inverse relationship from APQP.PPAPAbstract; no duplicate stored relationship.

fields.name: PPAP Completion Date
fields.type: Date (Date); max length unspecified; TimeZoneCapture=false
fields.edit: System read only
fields.lifecycle: Approve PPAP or non-safety Complete PPAP Action Handler writes local business date once; closed immutability.

fields.name: DisplayField
fields.type: Text (nvarchar); proposed target max 512 characters (baseline exported no maximum)
fields.default: Declarative continuing display calculation from inherited Project Framework Project.RecordNo, PPAP.Drawing Number and PPAP.Drawing Revision Code; no Product dependency
fields.edit: System calculated read only
fields.lifecycle: Target display calculation uses inherited RecordNo (Record No.), Drawing Number and Drawing Revision Code in that order, separator " / "; NULL context components omitted; verify expression syntax and input/output length before binding; never silently truncate identity.

fields.name: Target Configuration?
fields.type: Yes/No (Boolean)
fields.default: FALSE for existing; TRUE for target create path only
fields.edit: System read only; hidden
fields.lifecycle: Target Create handler sets TRUE before guarded shared handlers run; never toggle after creation.

fields.name: Type
fields.type: M:1 to PPAP Type; target 1; source 0..*; inverse disabled
fields.edit: Responsible engineer in Draft; read only after Issue; new selection filters Active?=TRUE; preserve existing inactive references read only
fields.lifecycle: Draft Save validates; immutable at Issue.

fields.name: Manufacturing Facility
fields.type: M:1 to Supplier Facility; target 0..1; source 0..*; inverse disabled
fields.edit: Engineer selects current eligible manufacturing facility in Draft; supplier read only; mandatory before Issue
fields.lifecycle: Issue freezes scope; never use inherited Location or Supplier as this relationship.

fields.name: Drawing Revision
fields.type: M:1 to Operational Drawing Revision; target 0..1; source 0..*; inverse disabled
fields.edit: System maps accepted operational source; engineer selects validated source in Draft; mandatory before Issue
fields.lifecycle: Issue freezes released engineering context; a different engineering change creates a NEW PPAP.

fields.name: Engineering Release
fields.type: M:1 to PPAP Engineering Release; target 0..1; source 0..*; inverse PPAP Engineering Release.PPAPs
fields.edit: Engineer selects accepted authoritative drawing/part context in Draft; mandatory before Issue for ALL origins including PCR/manual
fields.lifecycle: PCR/manual may reference the existing accepted released drawing context without a new ECS event; controlled intake captures it if absent. Create initializes source; Issue snapshots classifications; no in-flight absorption.

fields.name: Drawing Number
fields.type: Text; max 100 characters
fields.default: PPAP Engineering Release.Drawing Number at source selection
fields.edit: System read only; must be populated before Issue
fields.lifecycle: Controlled manual fallback imports authoritative source; issue locks number, no PPAP override.

fields.name: Drawing Revision Code
fields.type: Text; max 100 characters
fields.default: PPAP Engineering Release.Drawing Revision Code at source selection
fields.edit: System read only; mandatory before Issue
fields.lifecycle: Issue freezes original revision; later change creates new PPAP.

fields.name: Drawing Review
fields.type: M:1 to PPAP Drawing Review; target 0..1; source 0..*; inverse PPAP Drawing Review.PPAPs
fields.edit: System set by Launch PPAP; read only
fields.lifecycle: Retain initial review provenance.

fields.name: Originating PCR
fields.type: M:1 to MOC PCR; target 0..1; source 0..*; inverse disabled
fields.edit: System set by authorized Proceed to PPAP adapter; internal read only
fields.lifecycle: Idempotent launch per PCR decision token and approved scope; no shipment authorization.

fields.name: Replaces PPAP
fields.type: M:1 to PPAP; target 0..1; source 0..*; inverse disabled
fields.edit: Engineer selects relevant cancelled PPAP in Draft; read only after Issue
fields.lifecycle: Informational lineage only; does not bypass cancelled-source evidence exclusion.

fields.name: Service Parts Only?
fields.type: Yes/No (Boolean)
fields.edit: Engineer in Draft; mandatory validation against approved part purpose before Issue
fields.lifecycle: Eligibility adapter queries central supplier status capabilities; service flag is purpose, not a supplier-status override.

fields.name: Visibility Classification
fields.type: M:1 to Shared Record Visibility Classification; target 1; source 0..*; inverse disabled
fields.edit: Designated visibility manager only; supplier read only
fields.lifecycle: Controlled audited ADR-084 handover may change access without changing criticality, workflow or ownership.

fields.name: Model Change
fields.type: M:1 to PPAP Model Change; target 0..1; source 0..*; inverse PPAP Model Change.PPAPs
fields.edit: Engineer in Draft; required when Type.Code=NEW_MODEL; optional for explicit connected other types
fields.lifecycle: Changing Type away from NEW_MODEL does not silently clear populated context: Draft user confirms retention or clears all model fields together; immutable context after Issue.

fields.name: Manufacturing Stage
fields.type: M:1 to PPAP Manufacturing Stage; target 0..1; source 0..*; inverse disabled
fields.edit: Engineer in Draft; required when Model Change populated; hidden and NULL when no Model Change; new selection filters Active?=TRUE; preserve existing inactive references read only
fields.lifecycle: Draft context clearing clears stage after warning; issued context locked.

fields.name: Schedule Connected?
fields.type: Yes/No (Boolean)
fields.default: TRUE when Model Change selected; FALSE otherwise
fields.edit: Engineer may Disconnect/Reconnect while open with warning and reason; FALSE forced if Model Change NULL
fields.lifecycle: Schedule recalculation handler operates only when TRUE; manual dates persist disconnected.

fields.name: Template
fields.type: M:1 to PPAP Template; target 0..1; source 0..*; inverse disabled
fields.edit: Engineer in Draft; active published template matching Type; mandatory before Issue
fields.lifecycle: Select Template action resolves exact active published version; cannot switch while generated elements remain.

fields.name: Template Version
fields.type: M:1 to PPAP Template Version; target 0..1; source 0..*; inverse disabled
fields.edit: System read only; mandatory before Issue
fields.lifecycle: Initialize Elements resolves exact active version under lock, stores and never refreshes on later publication.

fields.name: Operating Policy
fields.type: M:1 to PPAP Operating Policy; target 1; source 0..*; inverse disabled
fields.edit: System read only
fields.lifecycle: Create handler binds single active operating policy; current configurable settings govern future reminders; issued deadline snapshots remain fixed.

fields.name: Engineer Routing Entity
fields.type: M:1 to Supplier Abstract; target 0..1; source 0..*; inverse disabled
fields.edit: Engineer or administrator in Draft; required before Issue; exact governed supplier context
fields.lifecycle: Resolve internal supplier-specific engineer role by Type and Operating Policy role mapping; no company-to-facility/depot fallback; issued routing context retained.

fields.name: Engineer Role
fields.type: M:1 to Supplier Specific Role; target 0..1; source 0..*; inverse disabled
fields.edit: System read only; required before Issue
fields.lifecycle: Resolve Engineer Routing Entity plus current policy role for Type; Project Owner must be current eligible member at Issue and on engineer action; reassignment stays in eligible role.

fields.name: Management Approver Pool
fields.type: M:1 to Group; target 0..1; source 0..*; inverse disabled
fields.edit: Administrator sets governed eligible group; mandatory before Issue when any selected part Important Safety?=TRUE
fields.lifecycle: Current membership validated on final action; no HR Immediate Supervisor shortcut.

fields.name: Final Management Approver
fields.type: M:1 to Employee; target 0..1; source 0..*; inverse disabled
fields.edit: Engineer selects current eligible pool member before Complete PPAP when management required; otherwise NULL and hidden
fields.lifecycle: Assign/reassign only while open, notify; engineer can select self if eligible; no automatic stage bypass.

fields.name: Issued Overall Due Date
fields.type: Date; no time component; business-day boundary uses PPAP Operating Policy.Business Time Zone
fields.edit: System read only; mandatory once issued
fields.lifecycle: Issue snapshots PPAP Due Date once.

fields.name: Issued At
fields.type: Date/Time; time-zone support enabled; store UTC, display user zone
fields.edit: System read only
fields.lifecycle: Issue writes authenticated server timestamp once; retained after closure.

fields.name: Issued By
fields.type: M:1 to Employee; target 0..1; source 0..*; inverse disabled
fields.edit: System read only
fields.lifecycle: Issue writes actual actor.

fields.name: Scope Confirmed At
fields.type: Date/Time; time-zone support enabled; store UTC, display user zone
fields.edit: System read only
fields.lifecycle: Confirm Scope supplier action writes once; no mass requirement at this point.

fields.name: Scope Confirmed By
fields.type: M:1 to Employee; target 0..1; source 0..*; inverse disabled
fields.edit: System read only
fields.lifecycle: Confirm Scope writes authenticated supplier actor; actual platform external-user identity binding must be verified.

fields.name: Replacement Required?
fields.type: Yes/No (Boolean)
fields.edit: System read only; internal warning and supplier non-technical action hold
fields.lifecycle: Source correction handler sets TRUE only for authoritative criticality correction applicable to this issued original context; blocks finalization until engineer cancels/replaces. Different engineering revision alone never sets it.

fields.name: Replacement Reason
fields.type: Text; max 2000 characters
fields.edit: System read only; required when Replacement Required?=TRUE, otherwise NULL
fields.lifecycle: Source correction handler stores affected context and changed flags; reason persists on cancellation.

fields.name: Management Submitted At
fields.type: Date/Time; time-zone support enabled; store UTC, display user zone
fields.edit: System read only
fields.lifecycle: Complete PPAP writes current submission/resubmission time on entry to Management Review; native workflow retains each prior entry.

fields.name: Management Review Due Date
fields.type: Date; no time component; business-day boundary uses PPAP Operating Policy.Business Time Zone
fields.edit: System read only; hidden unless Management Review or its history
fields.lifecycle: Complete PPAP computes local submission date plus current policy Management Review Days; freeze for that review cycle.

fields.name: Management Return Comment
fields.type: Text; max 2000 characters
fields.edit: Current eligible management approver; internal only; required for Return for More Information; otherwise retain prior value read only
fields.lifecycle: Return Action Handler validates nonblank, writes audit/workflow history; never include in supplier notification.

fields.name: Cancellation Reason
fields.type: Text; max 2000 characters
fields.edit: Responsible engineer or PPAP administrator through Cancel PPAP only; required on cancellation; otherwise NULL
fields.lifecycle: Cancel writes before cascade; preserve after terminal cancellation.

fields.name: Cancelled At
fields.type: Date/Time; time-zone support enabled; store UTC, display user zone
fields.edit: System read only
fields.lifecycle: Cancel PPAP writes only after outstanding work cascade succeeds.

fields.name: Cancelled By
fields.type: M:1 to Employee; target 0..1; source 0..*; inverse disabled
fields.edit: System read only
fields.lifecycle: Cancel PPAP writes actual actor after successful cascade.

fields.name: Approved At
fields.type: Date/Time; time-zone support enabled; store UTC, display user zone
fields.edit: System read only
fields.lifecycle: Final approval or non-safety Complete PPAP writes once, in same logical transaction as immutable output creation.

fields.name: Approved By
fields.type: M:1 to Employee; target 0..1; source 0..*; inverse disabled
fields.edit: System read only
fields.lifecycle: Records actual authenticated approving actor; engineer for non-safety; eligible management actor for safety.

fields.name: Approved Manufacturing Facility Label
fields.type: Text; max 255 characters
fields.edit: System read only; required at approval, NULL beforehand
fields.lifecycle: Approval Action Handler snapshots Manufacturing Facility native display value with its stable identity; native display-field binding verified under certificate gate; immutable source for certificate rendering/authorized retry.

fields.name: Approved Supplier Label
fields.type: Text; max 255 characters
fields.edit: System read only; required at approval, NULL beforehand
fields.lifecycle: Approval Action Handler snapshots Manufacturing Facility.ParentCompany native display value; exact existing shared field binding verified before build; stable facility/company identity remains in shared relationship; immutable certificate evidence.

fields.name: Approved Authority Label
fields.type: Text; max 255 characters
fields.edit: System read only; required at approval, NULL beforehand
fields.lifecycle: Approval Action Handler snapshots authenticated Approved By native display value; actual actor identity remains Approved By; label immutable so later person-name changes cannot rewrite certificate.

fields.name: Certificate Reference
fields.type: Text; max 100 characters
fields.edit: System read only; authorized supplier/internal view after approval
fields.lifecycle: Approve allocates unique opaque reference; verification always requires authorized access; QR optional, no public endpoint assumed.

fields.name: Approval Certificate
fields.type: Native Intelex attachment collection; native file identity, name, length and content type; no new file table
fields.edit: Read only authorized download after approval
fields.lifecycle: Approval renderer creates controlled PDF from approved frozen package; exactly one active issued artifact, retry by Certificate Reference; retain original bytes.

constraints: Native audit/security enabled on PPAP and all target operational children; hard delete denied after creation.
Issue requires >=1 selected part, all authoritative flags, exact source mapping, approved template/version, required due dates, and nonempty required role memberships.

Source correction applicable to original context holds finalization for cancel/replace; later distinct revision creates a separate PPAP without cancelling older work.

fields.name: Answers
fields.type: Inverse 1:M grid from PPAP Evidence Answer.Evidence Snapshot
fields.edit: Read only; apply record and attachment security independently
fields.lifecycle: Navigation over source relationship only; no second stored relationship.

constraints: Frozen content at Submit/Retain; review stamps are action-only write-once metadata.
Fresh attempt cannot be both Approved and Rejected. Rejected evidence is internal historical data, never a candidate for reuse.
Candidate owning PPAP must not be Cancelled; approved snapshot may remain eligible during non-engineering correction. Existing receiving copies are never edited on source cancellation.
No custom notification, audit, workflow or error-log object is added.
